question: Can a separately versioned strict validator reject retained semantic corruption cases while accepting byte-pinned, numerically reproduced synthetic baseline?
claim_scope: Artifact integrity engineering and finite numerical replay only. No new biological, clinical, empirical, or mechanism evidence; original failed acceptance remains FAILED/INCOMPLETE.
untouched: all original results and failure reports

frozen_semantics.selection: one-response mutual information maximum; smallest x for scores within 1e-14 of maximum

implementation: New standalone standard-library validator recomputes binomial-count exact targets and all 60 seeded histograms. It imports no author baseline code. New guarded exact function validates all probabilities before arithmetic; undefined posterior support must reject. Original code stays unchanged. Historical independent ordered-sequence oracle will be replayed separately if admitted.
acceptance: Verify all original file SHA256 values unchanged before and after.
Fresh original baseline replay must match every non-runtime/non-platform numerical output and all 60 histograms. Replay runs in a disposable copy, never over original evidence.
New validator accepts pinned original mathematical payload and new replay; every compared number finite, abs tolerance 1e-12; rational strings and histograms exact.

Reject seven old report cases: histogram-total change; total-preserving histogram transfer; diagnostic EIG+0.125; diagnostic C confidence=0; ordinary EIG=NaN; selected input=-1 changed to1; duplicate seed.

Reject additional predeclared cases: negative histogram; noninteger count; missing/duplicate configuration; reordered designs; truth-label change; rational mass tamper; posterior mean tamper; pooled estimate tamper; protocol-hash tamper; numeric bool substitution; infinity; missing mathematical field; unexpected nested field.
Strict JSON rejects NaN, Infinity, -Infinity and duplicate object keys.
Probability entry rejects p<0,p>1,NaN,+/-Inf,boolean at each a,b,t parameter; unknown truth; candidate endpoints with unsupported posterior bins. Valid rational interior probability fixtures accept.

Cross-session reviewer examines protocol and code and independently recalculates exact recovery/EIG and verifies mutation outcomes without importing new validator for mathematical expectations. Review scope and any holdouts reported separately.
No original failed verdict erased; any new test failure means this candidate is FAILED/INCOMPLETE and preserved. No retuning acceptance or rerunning to hide failed candidate.

budget.wall_rule: All preparation, waiting, execution and review after start count. No extension without a newly documented round.
replay_pass_allocation: at most one independent reviewer seeded replay

stop: No computation until public scope claim authorized and recorded, protocol frozen, admit succeeded, and reviewer clears material protocol concerns. Stop at budget, unexpected integrity failure, or tested candidate failure; preserve outputs. Operational setup fixes may be retried with logs, never silently revise evidence.
interpretation: Passing finite adversarial fixtures does not establish universal validator security, all-model robustness, real neural validity, or new discovery. Historical oracle reuse is cross-implementation replay, not a new independently authored algorithm. Separate current reviewer is required for independent validation label.
failure_register: Prior original six semantic mutations accepted and invalid truth probability accepted; retained as historical failures.
Setup failed argument-length materialization before execution, then exact blob verification succeeded.
Exact commit reconstruction initially failed due trailing newline assumption; exact source hash subsequently matched original no-newline message.
amendment: New round after expired unexecuted preparation. Same mathematical specification, mutation fixture definitions, and acceptance. Updated artifact paths/round identity/deadline only. Fresh searches and public claim recorded.
baseline_replay_rule: All other JSON paths, field sets and values must match byte-pinned original parsed data exactly. Metadata equality is reproduction only, never scientific acceptance.
freeze_rule: Hash protocol, strict_validator.py, run_validation.py and mutations.json before first test. No revisions after first test within this round.
